definition.def: A sphere is an object that is completely round in shape like a ball.
A sphere of activity or interest is a particular area of activity or interest.
examples: ...nurses, working in all spheres of the health service. [+ of]

definition.def: A sphere of people is a group of them who are similar in social status or who have the same interests.
examples: ...the realities of life outside the government and academic spheres of society. [+ of]

definition.def: A country's sphere of influence is an area of the world where it has a lot of influence.
examples: They see the region as their natural sphere of influence.
...countries traditionally within the British or American spheres of influence.
